json: UTF-8; reject duplicate property names, NaN and infinities, unknown fields; max JSON body 1 MiB; no silent coercion

idempotency.digest: SHA256 of RFC8785 canonical JSON containing context, payload, method and route; exclude transport headers
idempotency.concurrent: Unique key and transactional pending receipt; one committer; duplicate waits <=2s then 409 E_GATE_BLOCKED with Retry-After 1
idempotency.replay: Authorize current principal/context/object/fields before returning existing authorized receipt
idempotency.conflict: Same key different digest ->409; key expiry does not bypass durable source_event_id/receipt/snapshot uniqueness

pagination.cursor: Opaque authenticated token containing version, tenant, principal, scope revision, filter digest, last tuple, as_of timestamp and expiry
pagination.changed_scope: discard cursor and restart; no previous total or hidden count
pagination.count: Omitted; no count over undiscoverable records

concurrency.commit: state + receipt + audit + outbox in one database transaction
concurrency.failure: No effect on failed transaction; external effects only after committed outbox

events.order: Per aggregate sequence, not wall clock; park gap, reconcile source, never guess missing transition
events.after_exhaustion: Durable dead-letter and alert; authorized operator replay same event_id
events.compatibility: Consumers handle registered event types only; invalid schema quarantined; schema version changes explicit

upload.transport: Application upload gateway; no direct durable bearer URL; chunk digest and exact length checked on ingress
upload.finalize: Serialize with PUT/abort; validate part coverage then durable job; full digest verification produces quarantined artifact only
upload.availability: Scanner and custodian release required before preview, search, AI, use or export
upload.recovery: Read acknowledged parts; resend missing parts using same index/digest; conflicting digest requires new session
upload.expiry: No resume after expiry; current rights required throughout; cleanup idempotent after retention/hold evaluation
